require 'mongo'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'securerandom'

module Workers
  class JobProcessor
    SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT = 30
    MAX_RETRIES = 3

    attr_reader :logger, :running, :db

    def initialize(config = {})
      @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
      @running = true
      @current_job = nil
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      @db = Mongo::Client.new(
        config.fetch(:mongo_uri, 'mongodb://localhost:27017'),
        database: config.fetch(:database, 'jobs_db'),
        server_selection_timeout: 5
      )
      setup_signal_handlers
    end

    def setup_signal_handlers
      %w[INT TERM].each do |signal|
        Signal.trap(signal) do
          @logger.info("Received #{signal}, initiating graceful shutdown...")
          @running = false
        end
      end
    end

    def run
      logger.info("Worker started, processing jobs...")
      while @running
        job = fetch_next_job
        if job
          process_job(job)
        else
          sleep 1
        end
      end
      graceful_shutdown
    end

    private

    def fetch_next_job
      collection = @db[:job_queue]
      collection.find_one_and_update(
        { status: 'pending' },
        { '$set' => { status: 'processing', started_at: Time.now, worker_id: worker_id } },
        sort: { priority: -1, created_at: 1 },
        return_document: :after
      )
    rescue Mongo::Error => e
      logger.error("Failed to fetch job: #{e.message}")
      nil
    end

    def process_job(job)
      @mutex.synchronize { @current_job = job }
      logger.info("Processing job #{job['_id']} of type #{job['type']}")

      case job['type']
      when 'user_lookup'
        handle_user_lookup(job)
      when 'report_generation'
        handle_report_generation(job)
      when 'data_aggregation'
        handle_data_aggregation(job)
      else
        mark_job_failed(job, "Unknown job type: #{job['type']}")
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      handle_job_error(job, e)
    ensure
      @mutex.synchronize { @current_job = nil }
    end

    def handle_user_lookup(job)
      params = job['params'] || {}
      query = build_user_query(params)
      results = @db[:users].find(query).to_a
      mark_job_completed(job, { results: results.length })
    end

    def build_user_query(params)
      query = {}
      query[:active] = true

      if params['filter_field'] && params['filter_value']
        field = sanitize_field_name(params['filter_field'])
        query[field] = sanitize_scalar_value(params['filter_value'])
      end

      if params['search_criteria']
        query.merge!(parse_search_criteria(params['search_criteria']))
      end

      query
    end

    def sanitize_field_name(field)
      # Only allow alphanumeric and underscore in field names
      cleaned = field.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_.]/, '')
      # Prevent operator injection in field names
      return 'invalid_field' if cleaned.start_with?('$')
      cleaned
    end

    def sanitize_scalar_value(value)
      case value
      when String, Integer, Float, TrueClass, FalseClass, NilClass
        value
      else
        value.to_s
      end
    end

    def parse_search_criteria(criteria)
      return {} unless criteria.is_a?(Hash)
      safe_criteria = {}

      criteria.each do |key, value|
        safe_key = sanitize_field_name(key)
        next if safe_key == 'invalid_field'
        safe_criteria[safe_key] = sanitize_scalar_value(value)
      end

      safe_criteria
    end

    def handle_report_generation(job)
      params = job['params'] || {}
      pipeline = build_aggregation_pipeline(params)
      results = @db[:analytics].aggregate(pipeline).to_a
      mark_job_completed(job, { report_rows: results.length })
    end

    def build_aggregation_pipeline(params)
      pipeline = []

      if params['date_range']
        pipeline << {
          '$match' => {
            'timestamp' => {
              '$gte' => parse_date(params['date_range']['start']),
              '$lte' => parse_date(params['date_range']['end'])
            }
          }
        }
      end

      if params['group_by']
        group_field = sanitize_field_name(params['group_by'])
        pipeline << {
          '$group' => {
            '_id' => "$#{group_field}",
            'count' => { '$sum' => 1 }
          }
        }
      end

      pipeline << { '$limit' => 1000 }
      pipeline
    end

    def handle_data_aggregation(job)
      params = job['params'] || {}
      collection_name = resolve_collection(params['source'])
      match_stage = build_match_stage(params['conditions'])

      results = @db[collection_name].find(match_stage).limit(500).to_a
      mark_job_completed(job, { aggregated: results.length })
    end

    def resolve_collection(source)
      allowed = %w[events metrics logs sessions]
      allowed.include?(source.to_s) ? source.to_s : 'events'
    end

    def build_match_stage(conditions)
      return {} unless conditions.is_a?(Array)

      match = {}
      conditions.each do |condition|
        next unless condition.is_a?(Hash)
        field = sanitize_field_name(condition['field'])
        next if field == 'invalid_field'

        operator = condition['operator'].to_s
        value = condition['value']

        case operator
        when 'equals'
          match[field] = sanitize_scalar_value(value)
        when 'greater_than'
          match[field] = { '$gt' => value.to_f }
        when 'less_than'
          match[field] = { '$lt' => value.to_f }
        when 'contains'
          match[field] = { '$regex' => Regexp.escape(value.to_s), '$options' => 'i' }
        when 'in_list'
          match[field] = { '$in' => Array(value).map { |v| sanitize_scalar_value(v) } }
        end
      end

      match
    end

    def parse_date(date_str)
      Time.parse(date_str.to_s)
    rescue ArgumentError
      Time.now
    end

    def mark_job_completed(job, result_data = {})
      @db[:job_queue].update_one(
        { _id: job['_id'] },
        { '$set' => { status: 'completed', completed_at: Time.now, result: result_data } }
      )
      logger.info("Job #{job['_id']} completed successfully")
    end

    def mark_job_failed(job, error_msg)
      retries = (job['retries'] || 0) + 1
      if retries < MAX_RETRIES
        @db[:job_queue].update_one(
          { _id: job['_id'] },
          { '$set' => { status: 'pending', retries: retries, last_error: error_msg } }
        )
      else
        @db[:job_queue].update_one(
          { _id: job['_id'] },
          { '$set' => { status: 'failed', retries: retries, last_error: error_msg, failed_at: Time.now } }
        )
      end
    end

    def handle_job_error(job, error)
      logger.error("Job #{job['_id']} failed: #{error.message}")
      mark_job_failed(job, error.message)
    end

    def graceful_shutdown
      logger.info("Shutting down gracefully...")
      if @current_job
        logger.info("Waiting for current job to complete...")
        deadline = Time.now + SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT
        while @current_job && Time.now < deadline
          sleep 0.5
        end
        if @current_job
          logger.warn("Shutdown timeout reached, marking job as pending")
          mark_job_failed(@current_job, "Worker shutdown timeout")
        end
      end
      @db.close
      logger.info("Worker shutdown complete")
    end

    def worker_id
      @worker_id ||= "worker-#{SecureRandom.hex(8)}"
    end
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $0
  worker = Workers::JobProcessor.new(
    mongo_uri: ENV.fetch('MONGO_URI', 'mongodb://localhost:27017'),
    database: ENV.fetch('MONGO_DB', 'jobs_db')
  )
  worker.run
end
